name: session-status
description: Files each Code-tab session into a status section (In Progress, Waiting for Feedback, Testing, Code Review, Code Review: waiting for fix, Done) by what the session does, per project folder with an optional prefix. Desktop app only. Beta.

folders.title: Folders
folders.description: Comma-separated folders the mod acts in, each `path` or `path=PREFIX` (~ allowed), e.g. `~/src/foo=FOO, ~/src/bar=BAR, ~/src/baz`. A session counts when its working directory is one of them or lies below one, worktrees included; the deepest match wins. A prefix names that folder's sections `PREFIX · <status>`. Empty: the mod acts nowhere.

done.title: Done section
done.description: File a session whose turn ends with no open question, no open PR and no pending fix under Done. Off: it stays under In Progress.
